args.title: Use correct public application URL in password reset email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured application URL from the shared config (or process.env.APP_URL / config) instead of falling back to localhost:3000 when BASE_URL is not set, or ensure BASE_URL reads from the correct config property so production emails point to the correct domain.
